text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today's main race is the Hanshin JF... 
That's the race Lady Ramonu is running in.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
From here on, other girls of our 
generation will emerge as rivals to Lady 
Ramonu as she aims for the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...I know it hasn't even started yet, 
but... Will one really appear? A 'rival', 
I mean—

Once Mejiro Ramonu was ready and stepped 
into the underground paddock walkway—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! Mejiro Ramonu...—
choice_data_list: (All eyes are on me at once...!)

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. Just like we talked about 
earlier, keep your eyes only on Mejiro 
Ramonu. Stick right behind her at all 
times—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Such intense presence... 
...U-Ugh... I-I'm scared...

The spectators, and even the running 
Umamusume and their Trainers, seemed to 
believe it would be a showdown between 
Mejiro Ramonu and everyone else...

As long as it doesn't affect Mejiro 
Ramonu's mental state, the situation works 
in our favor, but...
choice_data_list:
And they're all such wonderful girls, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Please go on.
choice_data_list:
...I just thought it'd be a waste to leave 
it like this.

text_block_list.text:
The girls who can run in Junior Class GⅠs 
possess talent that far surpasses their 
peers. That makes it all the more 
unfortunate when they can't perform at 
full strength.
choice_data_list: I know I can run a great race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Quite so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hey, you over there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The finishing burst you showed in your 
last race— it was truly magnificent over 
the final two furlongs.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eh... What?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"As for you... I watched the footage of 
your uphill training."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
On today's course, if you came bearing 
down on me right before the goal... that 
would be quite a threat.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: !! Ramonu-san... to me...—

"Her feedback is precise and shows she is 
truly looking at them as individuals. If I 
were to praise them, I'd probably use the 
exact same words."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... you truly see every single 
one of us... as your rivals?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...T-That's it! My trainee has strengths 
unique to them alone... A strategy that 
plays to those strengths—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't be scared... I have to do my 
best! I'll show them... my kind of 
running...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, everyone... Won't you clash with 
everything you have?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, you won't even step into my 
shadow.

Mejiro Ramonu reset the tunnel vision of 
her competitors, bringing their focus back 
to baseline while further fueling their 
fighting spirits.

—She had properly groomed a rival. When 
asked for the reason behind it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I don't love just because I'm capable of 
loving."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I love because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A race cannot be completed by one person 
alone... Everything that comprises it 
requires passion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Devoting one's everything... All things. 
Winning that race is what gives it 
meaning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And so, at the very peak of that 
ascent—the supreme race awaits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What comes to your mind?

"Supreme races... There are so many races 
that have moved my heart. Recently, the 
undefeated Triple Crown comes to mind—and 
countless others follow right after."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to choose. Line them all 
up, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—Just imagine it... Me claiming victory 
in a race that transcends it all."

"...A race more wonderful than any I have 
ever seen... The passion of the spectators 
and the caliber of the Umamusume must be 
in a league of their own."

"Even so, there is only one victor. In the 
midst of the fiercest battle, Mejiro 
Ramonu crosses the finish line faster than 
anyone else. It's merely my imagination, 
and yet, completely irresistible—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Well? How is it?
choice_data_list: It feels just like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —A dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. What a sweet dream it is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To dedicate the supreme race. That is the 
destiny of this love..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I wonder how close... I can get today—
